svg.text: North branch · northern-third lake, defended nest and four-pillar combat arena · 40 × 36 tiles
PROPOSED LAYOUT • Top-down • 32px logical tiles • Plan only — not implemented
Top third is water; nest at north-wall center.
Griffin starts there and flies over the lake.
It fires long-range laser beams from the air.
Coco flies to deliver optional collected items.
Nest approach triggers its defensive return.
Coco places a vortex close to the shoreline.
Its pull draws the airborne Griffin onto land.
Four ruined pillars provide collision targets.
Griffin remains vulnerable to normal attacks.
Sieg lingering in place provokes a headbutt.
The fast charge is difficult to dodge unaided.
Slow Time slows laser / charge progression.
Sieg can evade or move Coco out of danger.
Hit pillar → it falls on Griffin → brief stun.
While stunned, attack OR fly to the nest.
Mirror distracts; shears then cut its hair.
Otherwise it returns to defend the approach.
No items: defeat it with combat + pillars.
Automatic cut → one wig; retain both tools.
Coco pulls Griffin ashore → Sieg baits a headbutt → Slow Time enables a dodge behind a ruined pillar.
Pillar impact stuns Griffin: attack during recovery, or use the opening for Coco’s Flight / item delivery.
Optional nest route: deliver mirror → distraction → deliver shears → automatic haircut → one wig; no defeat needed.
Retry: restore pillars and boss state; retain quest items. Prevent chain-stuns; spent pillars must not make victory impossible.
Gold: Sieg / physical • Purple: Coco / magic • Cyan: mechanism / return • Dashed: link or conditional access
